facts.claim: The Geoscience Australia tool (https://geodesyapps.ga.gov.au/sunrise) lets a user search the gazetteer for a place name, or enter a location by latitude and longitude (including locations outside Australia), choose a time zone, pick an event (sunrise/sunset, civil, nautical or astronomical twilight, sun transit time) and get results for a single day or a whole year.
